name: winbond-anomaly-event-manager
description: Winbond MA21 EAP/EES Engineer Anomaly Event Management System Exam A

scripts.dev: concurrently "nodemon --ignore backend/database.json --ignore backend/database.db backend/server.js" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/clean-frontend-dist.ps1 && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.cloudflare:db:create: set NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca&& npx --yes --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org wrangler d1 create winbond-anomaly-db --binding DB --update-config
scripts.cloudflare:db:init: set NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca&& npx --yes --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org wrangler d1 execute winbond-anomaly-db --remote --file=cloudflare/d1-schema.sql --yes
scripts.cloudflare:dev: npm run build && set NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca&& npx --yes --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org wrangler pages dev frontend/dist
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: npm run build && set NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca&& npx --yes --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist

author: Winbond Candidate
